notes: This bounded contract covers the FDD update-rate metadata, the official Get Update Rate Value / Get Update Rate Value For Attribute query boundary, and the retained designator state created by ordinary and regional attribute subscriptions in Umbra's non-installable embedded development profile. Named FDD rates are returned from the composed catalog, HLAdefault and the development-profile default aliases return the no-reduction value 0.0, and a valid known object attribute reports the retained ordinary/regional designator rate (or 0.0 when no declaration applies). A private UpdateRateGate now consumes those retained rates for bounded receive-order and timestamped callback admission, but the cross-cutting Lab contract for producer/subscriber rate difference, per-attribute delivery, MOM, transport, package evidence, protected review, catalog evidence, and conformance remains outside this metadata contract. The second Lab record is retained by its exact exported ID; its source page heading has a known 10.12/10.13.2 numbering drift documented in the local Lab observations.
